outcomeNote: a mishna stating a rule with no dispute

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הֵבִיאוּ לְפָנָיו מָלִיחַ תְּחִלָּה וּפַת עִמּוֹ — מְבָרֵךְ עַל הַמָּלִיחַ וּפוֹטֵר אֶת הַפַּת, שֶׁהַפַּת טְפֵלָה לוֹ. זֶה הַכְּלָל: כׇּל שֶׁהוּא עִיקָּר וְעִמּוֹ טְפֵלָה — מְבָרֵךְ עַל הָעִיקָּר וּפוֹטֵר אֶת הַטְּפֵלָה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If «they brought salted» food «before him» to eat «first and bread with it, he recites a blessing over the salted» food «and» thereby «exempts the bread, because» the salted food is primary while «the bread is secondary to it. This is the principle: Any» food «that is primary and a secondary» food «is with it, one recites a blessing over the primary and,» in so doing, «exempts the secondary» from its own blessing.

moves.cueHe: הביאו לפניו מליח תחלה ופת עמו
moves.summary: salted food first with bread: bless the salted food and exempt the bread; the rule: bless the primary and exempt the secondary
